title: The Dent house's broad dormer now rises over its roof's curb
items: At 1823 Prairie the dormer over the three-window group is rebuilt to the engraving and the 1883 album vignette: broad, its paired windows between two scrolled consoles, under a classical pediment that stands about a metre above the roof's top edge, as both pictures draw it.
The iron cresting along the roof's top edge stops on either side of the dormer, and the dormer's back is closed with slate over the roof deck.
